features.name: One-click Checkout
features.description: Eliminate 3-step checkout; reduces cart abandonment by an estimated 25%

notes: Edge case: confidence=10 (maximum). Raw RICE = (9×8×10)/4 = 180.0. kano_category reclassified from Must-have to Performance (2026-09-07): one-click checkout is a friction-reduction layer on the checkout baseline (which is Must-have), not itself non-negotiable. Users consciously compare checkout speed and smoothness — 'more/better = more satisfaction' is the linear Performance signature. The checkout feature category is Must-have; the one-click improvement of that checkout is Performance. Same reclassification pattern as p3-005 (model's classification was correct; original golden value was miscalibrated). The 1.3× Revenue multiplier applies only to priority_rank, never to rice_score.

notes: Edge case: confidence=2 (near-minimum) + effort=10 (maximum). Raw RICE = (10×9×2)/10 = 18.0. kano_category updated to Delight (2026-08-31): post-hardening 4-run probe (temperature=0) returned Delight on all 4 runs (rice_score=18.0 ✓ each run). Prior 'Performance' classification was stable pre-hardening but the RICE_SCORE prompt hardening (prompts.py L32–35) shifted kano reasoning. This is a real classification shift, not a fluke — confirmed by probe_p3005.py. The Delight classification is consistent with a high-effort, low-confidence, personalisation-focused feature that exceeds expectations rather than meeting a basic need.

features.name: Mobile Push Notifications
features.description: Re-engage users who have not opened the app in 7+ days via targeted push

notes: Raw RICE = (9×6×8)/5 = 86.4. kano_category reclassified from Must-have to Performance (2026-09-07): mobile push notifications for re-engagement do not meet the absence-causes-strong-dissatisfaction bar of Must-have — most apps ship without push notifications and users routinely disable them without leaving the product. Re-engagement via push is a quality-judged retention mechanism (frequency, relevance, timing all linearly affect satisfaction), which is the Performance signature. Same reclassification pattern as p3-005 — original golden value was miscalibrated, not the model. The 1.3× Retention multiplier applies only to priority_rank, never to rice_score.
